# War Scroll Column 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** complete

---

**6:1** And the men-of the-shield-line shall be-arranged, one-thousand on-each-side, and the shields shall cover the front-of the-rank, and none shall be-exposed to the weapons-of the-enemy.

**6:2** And the infantry shall be-arranged rank upon rank, and the men-of the-first-rank shall hold spears-of bronze, seven cubits in-their-length, with points-of polished-iron.

**6:3** And the men-of the-second-rank shall hold shields and javelins, and they-shall-stand prepared behind the first-line-of-battle to strengthen the formation.

**6:4** And the trumpeters shall station-themselves behind the battle-line, six priests blowing upon the trumpets-of-assembly, and they-shall-hold the trumpets-of-signal in-their-hands continually.

**6:5** And they-shall-blow upon-them a sustained-blast for-the-advance-of the-battle, and the infantry shall-go-forth to-the-battle-lines-of the-enemy.

**6:6** And they-shall-blow upon the trumpets-of-retreat, a broken-blast, to-signal the return-of the-men to the line-of the-first-rank when-they-have-completed their engagement.

**6:7** And in-seven lots-of-engagement shall-the-Sons-of-Light prevail in-three, subduing wickedness, and-the-Sons-of-Darkness shall-prevail in-three, bringing-low the army-of-light.

**6:8** And-in-the-seventh lot the-great-hand-of-God shall subdue Belial and-all the-angels-of-his-dominion, and all-the-men-of his-lot.

**6:9** And the holy-ones shall-shine-forth to-the-aid-of truth, to-the-destruction-of the-Sons-of-Darkness. And there-shall-be great-slaughter before the-God-of-Israel.

**6:10** For this-is the-day appointed by-Him from-of-old for the war-of-annihilation against the-Sons-of-Darkness. On-it shall-engage the congregation-of-the-divine-ones and the assembly-of-the-men in great-slaughter.

**6:11** And they-shall-blow upon the trumpets-of-signal for-the-ordering-of the-battle-ranks into-their-divisions against-all the battle-lines-of the-enemy.

**6:12** And upon the trumpets-of-assembly they-shall-blow a sustained-blast for-the-deployment-of the-hand-of-battle, and the priests shall-blow upon the six trumpets-of-the-slain a shrill staccato-blast.

**6:13** And upon the trumpets-of-ambush they-shall-blow a signal for-the-opening-of the-gates-of-war, and the infantry shall-go-forth and-shall-station-themselves in-their-ranks.

**6:14** And the horsemen shall-be to-the-right and-to-the-left-of the-battle-formation, and their-cavalry shall-be-deployed on-both-flanks, spreading-outward to-cause-fear.

**6:15** And there-shall-be one-thousand horsemen with the men-of the-line-of-battle, five-hundred on-the-right-flank and five-hundred on-the-left.

**6:16** And their-horses shall-be swift-stallions, tender-of-mouth, long-of-wind, full in-their-measure, mature but-not old, trained for-battle and-accustomed to-hearing.

**6:17** And those-who-ride-upon-them shall-be men-of-valor, skilled in-riding, and the span-of-their-age shall-be from thirty years to forty-five years.

---

*EMET notes: Column 6 is well preserved. The seven-lot structure (lines 7-10) is a distinctive feature of 1QM eschatological warfare. Hyphenated construct chains preserve Hebrew compound expressions. "Lots" (goralot) rendered literally as military engagements determined by divine allotment.*
